claimChecks.claim: Asopa 86-87% proves equivalence to dorsal onlay

claimChecks.note: Observed 88% versus 86.4% with no formal equivalence design or universal technique ranking.

claimChecks.claim: Cordon's 80-84% compares ventral with dorsal graft location
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract Methods/Results: 46 pseudospongioplasty versus 56 conventional spongioplasty cases, both ventral BMG coverage
claimChecks.note: Separated two ventral-coverage methods from dorsal comparison; full methods/tables remain unread.

claimChecks.claim: 5% versus 25% 3-month erectile dysfunction is general effect of ventral versus dorsal onlay
claimChecks.locator: Original main article Methods selection/chronological switch and Results, n=60/73
claimChecks.note: Scoped to selected primary nontraumatic proximal bulbar men; center changed approach over time, limiting causal inference. Supplementary tables not inspected.

claimChecks.claim: Sterling transurethral ventral inlay has 95% patency at a fixed 36-month endpoint
claimChecks.locator: Publisher abstract Methods/Results: 44 with >=1-year follow-up; mean 36 months, IQR 22-50
claimChecks.note: Retained the reported 95% with mean-follow-up wording; full body/video unresolved.

claimChecks.claim: VUAS periosteal quilt has durable 100% success
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract Methods/Results: four patients, all incontinent, 3-month flow/patency
claimChecks.note: Framed as four-patient early feasibility only; full technique and later follow-up not obtained.

claimChecks.claim: Triangular extension prevents all restenosis and gave 0% versus 20% final success
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract Methods/Results: 23 versus 24 first-stage cohorts, 20/20 reaching second stage
claimChecks.note: Distinguished first-stage stomal revisions 0/23 versus 5/24 from 19/20 second-stage success in both cohorts.

claimChecks.claim: Barbagli 2006 fibrin glue means no restricture for all patients through 12-24 months and proves advantage over sutures
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract Methods/Results: n=6; 6/12-month assessments; mean follow-up 16, range 12-24
